snippet.title: Ocean Animals for Kids — Meet the Sea!
snippet.description:
Ocean animals for kids! Dive under the sea with Pip the Owl and meet friendly sea animals.

Learn about a happy dolphin, a color-changing octopus, a gentle sea turtle, a smiling shark, a tiny sea horse, and the giant blue whale. A fun, gentle nature video that helps little ones discover ocean for kids and learn sea animals.

0:00 Meet Pip & dive in!
0:20 Explore ocean animals
2:30 Wow Fact: the giant blue whale
3:30 Recap: all our sea friends

Join Pip the Owl on a nature adventure!

#oceananimalsforkids #natureforkids #learningforkids #animalsforkids #underthesea #seaanimals
